about: The Workbench icons of the Maelstrom drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 48x48 icon (icon.bmp, saved as art/maelstrom.png; Maelstrom's artwork is CC BY 3.0, see COPYING.txt). Maelstrom-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Maelstrom.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Maelstrom.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Maelstrom, the licences and Ambrosia's notes; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
